summary: MoodFood planner regression + phone OTP tests — ALL PASS. Backend (5/5 pytest pytest_planner_phone_otp.xml): (BUG #3) POST /api/weekly-plan/generate now REPLACES the week's plan — first gen with dietary_preference=['non-vegetarian'] then second gen with ['vegetarian'] returns a new plan.id, /weekly-plan/current returns the NEW plan, only ONE plan doc exists for the week (verified via GET /weekly-plan list), and meal-name overlap is <100% confirming the diet actually flipped. (FEATURE #4/#5) /weekly-plan/generate accepts dietary_preference as an array (['vegetarian','non-vegetarian']) AND day_specific_preferences ({Monday:vegetarian, Friday:non-vegetarian}) and returns a 200 plan with a full 7 days x 3 meals (each meal is a non-empty string). (AUTH #2) POST /api/auth/phone/send-otp returns {status:'pending', demo_otp:'######'} in preview; /verify-otp with that code returns access_token+user (is_new_user=true) and the token authenticates /auth/me correctly. Bad phone format -> 400; wrong code -> 400. Frontend (Playwright, 390x844 mobile viewport): welcome screen loads with toggle-phone; phone flow: tap toggle-phone -> input-phone -> phone-send -> input-otp appears -> phone-verify with fresh demo_otp -> user lands on tabs home (greeted 'Hi User-0942'). Planner tab: 'plan-diet-vegetarian' + 'plan-diet-non-vegetarian' can BOTH be active at the same time (both bg = rgb(198,107,61) accent, both show a ✓ check icon — multi-select confirmed). toggle-day-prefs expands the per-day rows, daypref-monday-auto / daypref-monday-vegetarian / daypref-friday-non-vegetarian all present, tapping daypref-friday-non-vegetarian visibly activates that chip and the header updates to 'Customise diet by day (1)'. Performance/images: verified 0 requests to source.unsplash.com and 8+ requests to images.unsplash.com — the retired-CDN regression is fixed at the RecipeCard.foodImage() layer as claimed. No React Native red screens; only benign expo warnings ('shadow*' deprecated, useNativeDriver on web, pointerEvents prop).
critical_code_review_comments: meal_planning.py:310 — regenerate now runs `db.weekly_plans.delete_many({user_id, week_start})` BEFORE inserting the new plan, so the old duplicate doc is cleared. Backend test confirms /weekly-plan lists exactly 1 doc per week after regenerate.

meal_planning.py:79 & :67 — AIWeeklyPlanRequest.dietary_preference and MealPreferencesCreate.dietary_preference use Union[str, List[str]] so the frontend can send either a scalar or an array without breaking older clients. day_specific_preferences is a plain Optional[Dict[str,str]] and is threaded into generate_ai_meal_plan(). Full 7x3 plan returned in tests.

auth.py:187–206 — send_phone_otp falls back to {status:'pending', demo_otp:otp} when Twilio SMS raises OR when Twilio creds are missing. That is exactly what welcome.tsx:45 surfaces as a toast (`res?.demo_otp`). Verified end-to-end in Playwright.

RecipeCard.tsx:36–46 — foodImage() now builds direct https://images.unsplash.com/<id>?w=500&q=70&auto=format&fit=crop URLs. Playwright network trace during welcome+home+planner shows 0 source.unsplash.com hits.

planner.tsx:30–40 — toggleDietary / setDayPref implement multi-select with a Set-like array and a {day:diet} dict; UI screenshot shows both Vegetarian and Non-Veg chips can be simultaneously active with ✓ check icons.
Nit (non-blocking): welcome.tsx:14 hero image URL is a real photo id but the same file at :88 uses expo-image with transition — fine. No functional issue.

seed_data_creation: Created fresh emails pl_test+<ts>@example.com/Test1234 and phone users +1555000xxxx / +1555222xxxx via /api/auth/register and /api/auth/phone/verify-otp during tests. Each phone verify creates one user doc; each regenerate test creates one weekly_plans doc and cleans up any stale copies via delete_many.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<public url> pytest backend/tests/test_planner_and_phone_otp.py -v`. AI-based plan generation takes ~15–20s per generate so the regenerate test uses 180s timeouts. Phone OTP send-otp is CALLED TWICE in the frontend E2E flow (once from UI, once from the test to grab the fresh demo_otp) because the toast-shown OTP is not readable via Playwright reliably; each send overwrites the in-memory otp_storage entry, so use the LAST demo_otp returned. Planner day-preference chips are only rendered after tapping toggle-day-prefs; the free tier only shows 2 preview days but the Planner controls (all 7 day rows) are always available. Ignore the /api/register-push 500 (placeholder Firebase key per agent-to-agent note).
rca_of_issue: N/A — the four fixes reviewed (regenerate-replaces, multi-diet array, day_specific_preferences, direct-CDN images) plus the new phone OTP flow are all working end-to-end. Root causes for the original bugs were: (a) generate endpoint was previously inserting a new weekly_plans doc without clearing the prior one for the same week_start, so /current returned the first (stale) doc; fix: delete_many({user_id, week_start}) prior to insert. (b) dietary_preference schema was Union[str, List[str]] but the array path was not consistently wired through the AI planner; day_specific_preferences was a new field. Both threaded through generate_ai_meal_plan(). (c) foodImage() was previously using source.unsplash.com which redirects and often hangs; replaced with direct images.unsplash.com CDN URLs keyed by keyword or deterministic hash fallback. (d) welcome.tsx now offers a phone auth branch that reads demo_otp from the send-otp response and shows it as a toast — validated via testIDs toggle-phone / input-phone / phone-send / input-otp / phone-verify.
